verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local, open-source Unix-like terminal app for iOS. It has no hosted service, account system, or API whose credentials could be issued or scoped, so least-privilege API credentials are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability; the directory access via pickFolder is an iOS sandbox file-access feature, not credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
